cs.t: i dunno, i use the netflix and amazon video clients on my ethernet-connected panasonic viera plasma all the time, multiple times per week. adding titles using my laptop, they just appear in the client and i select and play.  the netflix playlist interface is pretty good, i can browse series and titles quite easily. i've had it for 5 years now, and it still works fine.  i'm going to use it until it dies, probably in the next 2-3 years.
